title: FBbt new term request
description: Draft request for a new Drosophila anatomy (FBbt) term, generated when a cluster has no exact FBbt match. Mirrors the FlyBase drosophila-anatomy-developmental-ontology issue template: References + Term label(s) are the only required content; everything else is a non-authoritative suggestion for the curator.

cluster_label.description: The atlas cluster label this request is for (provenance, not part of the issue body).

references.description: REQUIRED by FBbt. Publications with information about the term, as FBrf / DOI / PMID.

term_labels.description: Proposed name(s) for the new term as used in the publication, or a pointer to where the type names appear (e.g. 'Table S3').

suggested_details.description: OPTIONAL, non-authoritative suggestions for the curator, derived from the literature report. FBbt curators author the authoritative definition/axioms; these only assist.

markers.description: Key marker genes (FlyBase symbols and FBgn ids).

ntr_markdown.description: Issue-ready markdown: the two required FBbt sections, followed by an optional clearly-marked 'Suggested details' block.
